description: This bar chart illustrates the average performance across five datasets—NQ, TQA, zsRE, T-rex, and HQA—for three different grounding supervision methods: “Standard,” “CinGS (w/)”, and “CinGS,” with the performance measured under two conditions: “With Context” and “Without Context.” The vertical axis, labeled “Average Performance,” is scaled linearly from 0 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis presents two main categories: “With Context” and “Without Context,” each containing three grouped bars corresponding to the three supervision methods. The “Standard” method is represented by a dark gray bar with a pattern of small circles, the “CinGS (w/)” method by a solid medium gray bar, and the “CinGS” method by a solid blue bar. Under “With Context,” the “Standard” bar reaches approximately 58, the “CinGS (w/)” bar reaches approximately 58, and the “CinGS” bar reaches exactly 60. Under “Without Context,” the “Standard” bar reaches approximately 47, the “CinGS (w/)” bar reaches approximately 48, and the “CinGS” bar reaches approximately 45. The bars are grouped side-by-side within each context condition, and the chart does not appear to be sorted by height. The blue bars, representing performance with context, are consistently taller than the corresponding purple bars for each supervision method, indicating higher performance with context. The bars are not visually emphasized beyond their color and pattern, and no annotations are present on the chart.
